method.appTreeDigest: cd App.app && find . -type f ! -path './_CodeSignature/*' ! -name embedded.mobileprovision | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 (first 16 hex)
method.publicDigest: cd App.app/public && find . -type f | sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256 (first 16 hex)
method.build: per arm, in a clean detached worktree at the commit: npm run perf:build:cap; then in ios/App: xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination id=<device> -derivedDataPath <dd-arm> -allowProvisioningUpdates build
method.note: Signed bundles, provisioning profiles, and signing identities are not published.
